item.title: Apache Camel camel-jms ObjectMessage Deserialization RCE (CVE-2026-40860)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2026-40860 (JIRA CAMEL-23321). Status: Weaponized (complete lab reproducer: vulnerable consumer, real broker, gadget that executes a command and a file-creation proof; not rebuilt while preparing this entry). Affects: Apache Camel camel-jms, plus the components that reach the same binding: camel-sjms, camel-sjms2, camel-amqp, camel-activemq and camel-activemq6. Tags: RCE, Java deserialization, JMS, ActiveMQ, Artemis, Camel, ObjectMessage, gadget chain, commons-collections, CWE-502.
